meta.keywords: stainless steel 316l sheet, stainless steel 316l plate, 316l plate, 316l 2b, 316l sheet, sa240 tp316l, stainless steel 316l shim, stainless steel 316l coils

description: 316L is a lower carbon version of the 316 alloys. The Stainless Steel 316L Sheet is an austenitic alloy containing nickel and molybdenum. These sheets are highly resistant to corrosion and can suffice under extreme temperatures. It is very durable in acidic solutions and chemical contaminations. The ASTM A240 TP316L Plate is widely used in heat exchangers, dyeing equipment, pipelines, construction material, pulp, and paper equipment along with many applications in the marine industry. We are the top manufacturers and suppliers of Stainless Steel 316L Sheet. We consider it our moral obligation to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The ASTM a240 type 316L Foil is low carbon austenitic alloy that has good forming and welding capabilities. These foils act as barriers to reduce heat transfer condensation in many industries. The SA240 tp316l Coil can be produced by hot rolling, cold rolling, galvanizing, or polymer coating. This sheet metal is supplied in the form of a coil. Construction and machine-building sectors are the main consumers of this coil. All our products can be custom made to suit all your requirements.

AISI 316L Shim Stock is a stock material, which can be cut to suit several applications. This material is used to provide support, fill gaps, and level equipment in industrial systems. They are available as rolls, flat sheets, or laminated flat sheets. The UNS S31603 Strip we produce are manufactured using the best raw materials and the latest technology. This allows it to be highly corrosion resistant as well as resist intergranular corrosion after welding. If you have any queries about our sheets or other products, contact us.

meta.description: We deal in Stainless Steel 321 Sheet which is used in various industry, Check ASTM A240/ SA240 TP321H Plate Sizes, Buy AMS 5510 Material at factory Price. Refer Dimensions of AISI 321 Coil/ Strip
meta.keywords: stainless steel 321 sheet, stainless steel 321 plate, 321 stainless steel coil, ss 321h plate, ams 5510 sheet, 321 sheet, 321 plate

description: 321 alloy is austenitic steel, which is stabilized with titanium. The Stainless Steel 321 Sheet can withstand temperatures up to 1500°F and has high resistance to intergranular corrosion. This sheet shows higher creep and stress rupture properties than the 304 alloys. The ASTM A240 TP321H Plate is highly resistant to corrosion and doesn’t rust easily like other normal carbon steel. It also possesses good welding and formation properties and doesn’t require post-annealing process. This alloy is widely used in chemical processing, jet engine parts, heat exchangers, and expansion joints. We are one of the top Stainless Steel 321 sheet manufacturers in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The AISI 321 Coil is in demand in the construction and manufacturing industries. These coils can withstand temperatures up to 816 Degree C. They are commonly produced either by hot-rolling or cold-rolling procedures at high temperatures. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best AMS 5510 Material using the best technology following international and national standards.

The 321H SS Foil is an economical alloy in the market. These non-heat-treated alloys are perfect for wrapping tools. It provides increased dimensional stability that allows it to reduce decarburization and other contaminations in these parts during heat treatment as well as cool hardening. These foils help reduce the problem of intergranular corrosion during the welding process by reducing the amount of carbon present. Our ASME SA240 Grade 321 Sheet along with all our products can be customized to suit different needs as per our client’s requirements. If you want to know more about these sheets or customize them, contact us to get more information.

description: Steel is measured by its grade based on its thickness, physical properties, and oxidation state. Stainless steel 310 sheet is a austenitic medium carbon alloy. They are widely used in various industries due to their high chromium and nickel content. This composition makes it extremely resistant to corrosion and erosion. These sheets can be used in high-temperature applications up to 1150°C. The ASTM A240 Type 310s Plate is a lower carbon version of the 310 sheets. The 310 and 310s alloys are widely used in petroleum refineries, burners, tube hangers, food-processing equipment, steam boilers, etc. We are one of the top Stainless steel 310 sheet manufactures in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

Most sheets and plates are produced by the hot-rolling or cold-rolling process. The AISI 310 Hot Rolled Plates are produced by rolling the steel at a high temperature of about 1700° F. This is above the recrystallization property of most steel. This enables the steel to be shaped properly. This process is cheaper as compared to cold-rolling of steel. Like the 310 sheets, the low carbon ASME SA240 Grade 310S Strip can be customized to different sizes to suit all your requirements.

Stainless steel is produced in slabs, which are later converted from Z mill into coils. The 310 Stainless Steel Coil can be defined into different names based on their appearance and processing. These coils are in high demand in the manufacturing and construction industries. The high-quality raw materials used in the preparation of these UNS S31000 Strip by our renowned workers allow them to withstand higher static stresses. If you have any queries regarding the Stainless steel 310 sheet or our other products, please contact us for more information.

description: Alloy 317 is an austenitic steel, which has 2-3% of molybdenum content. The Stainless Steel 317 Sheet is lower carbon steel that is highly resistant to corrosion. Apart from molybdenum, these sheets are made up of chromium and nickel along with a few trace elements. This gives them superior resistance to chloride, sulfide pitting, and crevice corrosion cracking. The ASTM A240 Type 317L Plate is the lower carbon version of the 317 sheets. Both 317 and 317L alloys have many applications in the petrochemical, oil and gas, food, and chemical industries. For many years we, have been one of the top Stainless Steel 317 Sheet manufacturers in the country. Our focus is set on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The UNS S31703 Strip is a product of a hot-rolled strip that has been pickled. These strips are prepared in mills, which are annealed to produce desired properties. The ASME SA240 SS 317L Shim Stock is used in most industries to provide support or fill gaps in equipment. These shims are easy to form and fabricate. All our products can be custom made into different shapes and sizes to suit our client’s requirements.

Alloy 317L Coil is obtained from stainless steel, which is made into slabs. This sheet metal, which is supplied in the form of a coil. These coils are a highly requested material in the manufacturing and construction industries. They are mainly formed either by hot or cold rolling procedures. Stainless steel 317L Cold Rolled Plate is hot rolled steel, which is subjected to more treatment. These plates are rolled at room temperature after cooling. This gives them more surface qualities and better dimensions. All our products are produced using the best raw materials and innovative technology. Contact us to know more.

description: 904L is low carbon non-stabilized austenitic steel. The Stainless Steel 904L Sheet is added with copper enabling it to have excellent resistance to reducing strong acids. This steel is also highly resistant to corrosion, cracking due to acids and crevice corrosion. The 904L has good strength and can withstand moderate temperatures. The ASTM B625 UNS N08904 Plate is non-magnetic steel, which offers excellent formability, toughness, and weldability properties. They have many applications in electrostatic applications, seawater-cooling systems, oil refineries, acid production plants, and many related industries. We are the leading manufacturers and suppliers of Stainless Steel 904L Sheet. Our main aim is to produce the best products and offer them at the most reasonable rates.

A stainless steel coil is a sheet or a strip of a finished steel product, which is coiled or rolled. The WNR 1.4539 Coil is highly demanded in the construction and manufacturing industry due to different properties and strength. These coils are mostly produced either in hot-rolls or cold rolls. The astm a240 type 904l coil is a low-carbon alloy that can be customized into different sizes to suit different functions just like all our products.

An ASME SB625 Shim Stock helps industries meet their spacing requirements. These shims are used to cover gaps, provide support and adjust industrial applications. They can also be used for electrical insulation, sealing joints, etc. The DIN 1.4539 Polished/ Mirror Plate is a product that is surface treated to have a smooth and reflective surface. This finish is achieved by surface treating this material mechanically while making use of abrasive material. All our products are manufactured, using the best raw materials and the latest technology. If you want to know more about them, contact us for more details.

The ASTM A240 TP316L Plate is widely used in heat exchangers, dyeing equipment, pipelines, construction material, pulp, and paper equipment along with many applications in the marine industry. We are the top manufacturers and suppliers of Stainless Steel 316L Sheet. We consider it our moral obligation to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The ASTM a240 type 316L Foil is low carbon austenitic alloy that has good forming and welding capabilities. These foils act as barriers to reduce heat transfer condensation in many industries. The SA240 tp316l Coil can be produced by hot rolling, cold rolling, galvanizing, or polymer coating. This sheet metal is supplied in the form of a coil. Construction and machine-building sectors are the main consumers of this coil. All our products can be custom made to suit all your requirements.

AISI 316L Shim Stock is a stock material, which can be cut to suit several applications. This material is used to provide support, fill gaps, and level equipment in industrial systems. They are available as rolls, flat sheets, or laminated flat sheets. The UNS S31603 Strip we produce are manufactured using the best raw materials and the latest technology. This allows it to be highly corrosion resistant as well as resist intergranular corrosion after welding. If you have any queries about our sheets or other products, contact us.

description: 321 alloy is austenitic steel, which is stabilized with titanium. The Stainless Steel 321 Sheet can withstand temperatures up to 1500°F and has high resistance to intergranular corrosion. This sheet shows higher creep and stress rupture properties than the 304 alloys. The ASTM A240 TP321H Plate is highly resistant to corrosion and doesn’t rust easily like other normal carbon steel. It also possesses good welding and formation properties and doesn’t require post-annealing process. This alloy is widely used in chemical processing, jet engine parts, heat exchangers, and expansion joints. We are one of the top Stainless Steel 321 sheet manufacturers in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The AISI 321 Coil is in demand in the construction and manufacturing industries. These coils can withstand temperatures up to 816 Degree C. They are commonly produced either by hot-rolling or cold-rolling procedures at high temperatures. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best AMS 5510 Material using the best technology following international and national standards.

The 321H SS Foil is an economical alloy in the market. These non-heat-treated alloys are perfect for wrapping tools. It provides increased dimensional stability that allows it to reduce decarburization and other contaminations in these parts during heat treatment as well as cool hardening. These foils help reduce the problem of intergranular corrosion during the welding process by reducing the amount of carbon present. Our ASME SA240 Grade 321 Sheet along with all our products can be customized to suit different needs as per our client’s requirements. If you want to know more about these sheets or customize them, contact us to get more information.

These sheets can be used in high-temperature applications up to 1150°C. The ASTM A240 Type 310s Plate is a lower carbon version of the 310 sheets. Most sheets and plates are produced by the hot-rolling or cold-rolling process. The AISI 310 Hot Rolled Plates are produced by rolling the steel at a high temperature of about 1700° F. Like the 310 sheets, the low carbon ASME SA240 Grade 310S Strip can be customized to different sizes to suit all your requirements.

Stainless steel is produced in slabs, which are later converted from Z mill into coils. The 310 Stainless Steel Coil can be defined into different names based on their appearance and processing. These coils are in high demand in the manufacturing and construction industries. The high-quality raw materials used in the preparation of these UNS S31000 Strip by our renowned workers allow them to withstand higher static stresses. This gives them superior resistance to chloride, sulfide pitting, and crevice corrosion cracking. The ASTM A240 Type 317L Plate is the lower carbon version of the 317 sheets. Both 317 and 317L alloys have many applications in the petrochemical, oil and gas, food, and chemical industries. For many years we, have been one of the top Stainless Steel 317 Sheet manufacturers in the country. Our focus is set on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The UNS S31703 Strip is a product of a hot-rolled strip that has been pickled. These strips are prepared in mills, which are annealed to produce desired properties. The ASME SA240 SS 317L Shim Stock is used in most industries to provide support or fill gaps in equipment. These shims are easy to form and fabricate. All our products can be custom made into different shapes and sizes to suit our client’s requirements.

Alloy 317L Coil is obtained from stainless steel, which is made into slabs. This sheet metal, which is supplied in the form of a coil. These coils are a highly requested material in the manufacturing and construction industries. They are mainly formed either by hot or cold rolling procedures. Stainless steel 317L Cold Rolled Plate is hot rolled steel, which is subjected to more treatment. These plates are rolled at room temperature after cooling. This gives them more surface qualities and better dimensions. All our products are produced using the best raw materials and innovative technology. Contact us to know more.

The ASTM B625 UNS N08904 Plate is non-magnetic steel, which offers excellent formability, toughness, and weldability properties. An ASME SB625 Shim Stock helps industries meet their spacing requirements. These shims are used to cover gaps, provide support and adjust industrial applications. They can also be used for electrical insulation, sealing joints, etc. The DIN 1.4539 Polished/ Mirror Plate is a product that is surface treated to have a smooth and reflective surface. description: Stainless steel is produced in slabs which are then made it coils after processing in Z mills. Stainless steel coils are further processed to give them different properties. The way each coil is wound gives it a specific name. Since A240 SS Sheet Coil is designed from austenitic stainless steel, they are highly resistant to all forms of corrosion and extreme temperatures. These stainless steel coils have different applications in the architectural industry, kitchen appliances; aircraft exhaust manifolds, heat exchangers, household appliances, etc. We are proudly one of the top Stainless Steel Coil Supplier in India, who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

Stainless steel coils are mostly manufactured by the process of either hot-rolling or cold-rolling. Hot rolling in strip-hot mills produces the Hot Rolled Stainless Steel Coil. The process can be continuous, reversing, or vice versa. These hot-rolled coils play an important role in producing ASTM A240 Cold Rolled Coil. Here, these coils are produced by rolling them in continuous or reversing mills without preheating them. Our renowned workers use the best raw materials and the latest technology while producing some of the finest products in the market.

The Stainless Steel Cooling Coil is formed from tubes or other material in industrial cooling systems. These tubes allow the fluid to pass through them when there is contact from air or gas thereby, allowing heat exchange. We also produce the Brushed Stainless Steel Coil, which comes in lengths up to 6000mm and width up to 3500mm. All our products can be customized into different shapes and dimensions to suit different requirements. If you have any questions about our products, contact us for more information.

description: Alloy ASTM A36 is a mild-carbon steel grade. ASTM A36 Carbon Steel Plate has excellent welding properties, which help in the process of punching, tapping, drilling, and grinding. These plates are preferably used in low-temperature applications. They are widely seen in use in many applications in construction, agricultural equipment, automotive industry, machinery parts, etc. We are proud to be the leading manufacturers of ASTM A36 Carbon Steel Plate, and our ultimate aim is to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The A36 Mild Steel Sheet has 0.05%-0.25% of carbon in its weight. These sheets have few other elements apart from iron, as they are not alloyed steel. Chromium and molybdenum are present in a lower concentration. The A36 Low CS Strip is another material, which has low carbon in its weight. These strips have less than 0.3% carbon and doesn’t provide much protection from corrosion. Low Temperature Carbon Steel Plate A36 is widely used in many applications in low-temperature piping systems. They are preferred by plumber’s for seamless tubing and transporting refrigerated material. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials and the best technology to produce the best products. This is done following international and national standards.

The ASME SA 36 CS Cold Rolled Sheet is a hot rolled steel, which is processed further. Once the rolls are cooled, they are rolled again at room temperature to achieve desirable properties and dimensions. Astm A36 Mild Steel Strips like our other products can be customized into different dimensions and shapes as per your requirements. If you have any queries regarding our products or pricing, contact us for more information.

description: Gr 70 plate is a medium carbon alloy, which contains manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, and silicon in its composition. The ASTM A515 Gr 70 Plates show excellent properties of high strength, wear-resistant, durability, and corrosion resistance. These plates are known for their exploits in the medium and higher temperature systems. They are widely used in welded pressure vessels, petrochemical industries, boilers, heat exchangers, etc. Over the last decade, we have been the leading manufacturer and supplier of ASTM A515 Gr 70 Plates. We ensure that the products we produce are top quality and available at reasonable rates to all.

The A515 Gr.70 Hot Rolled Steel Plates are produced in mills by processing them at 1,700˚F. Since this is above the recrystallization temperature of most metals, it makes the subsequent steel easy to form and the products easy to work with. ASME SA515 Grade 70 Sheet can be formed following conventional methods and it can be easily bent or cold-rolled. We are a one-stop destination to customize the SA 515 GR 70 Sheet along with our other products in different shapes and dimensions to suit all your needs.

The ASTM A515 Grade 70 Carbon Steel Pressure Vessel Plates are found in pieces of equipment in boilers, petrochemical, and petroleum industries. They don’t deform easily as they are designed to withstand high temperatures. The ASTM A515 grade 70 Boiler Steel Plates are one of the important materials required to manufacture boilers. They are made of thick superior quality carbon steel, which has controlled properties and can resist internal pressures. All the ASTM A515 Gr 70 Plates we produce are using the best raw materials and the best technology. If you want to know more about our products or pricing, contact us.

description: ASTM A515 standard is used in producing carbon, silicon steel plates. The ASTM A515 Gr 60 Plates can be used for medium or high-pressure applications. These plates have good strength and offer good weldability and fabrication properties. These plates are killed or semi-killed and are made with a coarse austenitic grain size practice. These plates have many applications in the heat exchangers, boiler tubes, pressure vessels, petrochemical, oil and gas industries, etc. We are one of the top manufacturers and suppliers of ASTM A515 Gr 60 Plates in the country for the past decade. Our ultimate aim is to produce the best products, which are available to all at reasonable rates.

The ASTM A515 Gr.60 Hot Rolled Steel Plates are processed at high temperatures in mills this allows the steel to form easily and the subsequent products easy to work with. The A515 BQ Gr 60 Plate has a width of 1500mm-3000mm and a length of 3000mm-11000mm. These plates are free from leakage from any liquid, which is used in it. The SA 515 GR 60 Polished Sheet is available in the form of brushed or mirror-like finish. All our products are produced using the latest technology and best raw materials.

The SA 515 Grade 60 Pressure Vessel Plate is carbon steel, which has good strength and is used in boilers and pressure vessels. These plates are designed to withstand heavy pressures and temperatures. The ASTM A515 Grade 60 Carbon Steel Plate we produce don’t have many alloying elements. This like all our products can be customized into different shapes and sizes to suit all your requirements. If you want to know more about our products or their pricing, contact us to find out more.

description: Titanium is a very durable metal that is 40% lighter than steel but is as strong as the hardest grade of steel. Titanium Grade 2 Sheet is the most versatile and pure grade of titanium. The minimum yield strength of this sheet is 335 Mpa, and the minimum tensile strength of Ti Alloy Gr 2 Strips is 510 Mpa. The Grade 2 sheets show resistance to corrosion, erosion, and chlorides. The ASTM B265 Ti Alloy Gr 2 Plate is unalloyed with normal oxygen concentration. Apart from this, it has a lower density and desirable for products with low weight. These sheets are widely seen in the medical industry, architecture, oil and gas, piping systems, heat exchangers, etc. We are the biggest manufactures of Titanium Grade 2 Sheet in the country. Our main aim is to provide the best quality products at reasonable rates.

The Cp Grade 2 Titanium Foil is widely used in industrial applications. This foil is used to wrap around tools as they are treated with heat. This non-magnetic tape provides increased dimensional stability. This gives it a chance to reduce contaminations and decarburization when it is heat-treated or cool hardened. Our experienced workers make use of the best raw materials using innovative technology to produce the best products. This is done while following international and national standards.

The UNS R50400 Shim Stock is a custom stock, which can be cut in appropriate shapes and sizes. This fills gaps, provides support to tools in industrial systems. The Cp Grade 2 Titanium Strip can be customized like our other products in different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. If you have any queries regarding our products or pricing, contact us.

Titanium Grade 5 Sheet is the most popular titanium alloy, which accounts for half of the titanium worldwide. This aluminum sheet is also composed of vanadium, iron, and oxygen. This sheet is used as a heat barrier to prevent its transfer to the rest of the assembly. This lightweight Astm B265 Ti Gr 5 Plate has good formability, high corrosion, and creep resistance. This grade of titanium has many applications in aerospace, sports equipment, fasteners, etc. We are one of the biggest manufacturers and suppliers of Titanium Grade 5 Sheet. Our main goal is to provide high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The Cp Grade 5 Titanium Coil is a ductile metal drawn from sheet metal and wound into coils. These coils show excellent fatigue and crack propagation. These coils can function under high temperatures as well as cryogenic temperatures. The WNR 3.7165 Cold Rolled Coil is processed further after hot-rolling to give it desired properties. All our products can be customized in different shapes and sizes as per your requirements.

The UNS N56400 Clad Plate combines a titanium plate into a multi-layer plate consisting of a thin layer of corrosion-resistant material. Titanium is claded with carbon steel, which allows it to be used in high-temperature applications. The Titanium Werkstoff No 3.7165 Shim Stock is used to support other products in industrial systems. These fill the gap and provides support to different tools. Our renowned workers use the best products and latest technology while producing all our products. This versatile material can be easily cut with scissors or shears depending on its thickness. The Sa 387 Gr 11 Cl 2 Foil is a non-magnetic tape, which is used to wrap industrial materials, as they are heat-treated. These foils help prevent intergranular corrosion caused due to welding. description: Grade 22 sheet is a chrome-moly grade due to the presence of high chromium and molybdenum. The Alloy Steel Grade 22 Sheet is designed with good strength and wear resistance. They also show high corrosion resistance and are recommended in high-temperature services. The ASTM A387 Gr 22 Plate is designed alloying with various carbon metals like aluminum, titanium, silicon, and manganese. This grade of alloy steel is found in many petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, pulp and paper, heat exchangers, etc. Over the last decade, we have been the leading manufacturer and supplier of Alloy Steel Grade 22 Sheet. We ensure that the products we produce are top quality and available at reasonable rates to all.

Grade 22 Alloy Steel Strip is a narrow thin stock usually having a size of 4.76mm or less in thickness. This strip is formed by many processes, which include welding, bending, removal of excess material, treatment of the material via heat and finally polishing or burnishing the strip. The SA387 Grade 22 Coil is a by-product of sheet metal, which is supplied in the form of a coil. This coil is in high demand in the manufacturing and construction industry. Our renowned workers use the best raw materials and latest technology when producing all our products.

The Astm A387 Gr 22 Cl 1 Cold Rolled Plates are produced after processing hot-rolled plates after cooling. These plates can be easily made into precise sizes having good surface quality along with mechanical properties. The 2B finish Astm A387 Grade 22 Class 1 Sheet is similar to a 2D finish, which is rolled by using polished rolls after they are cold-rolled. If you want to know more about our products or pricing contact us.

meta.keywords: Alloy Steel Grade 5 Sheet, Alloy Steel Gr 5 Circle, ASTM A387 Gr 5 Sheet, Alloy Steel Gr 5 Plates, Grade 5 Alloy Steel Polished Plates, Grade 5 Alloy Steel, SA387 Grade 5, Chrome Molybdenum Gr 5

description: Alloy steels are mostly made from various compositions like carbon, sulfur, phosphorous, chromium, copper, nickel, and molybdenum. The Alloy Steel Gr 5 Sheet is designed with good strength and toughness. They are also highly resistant to corrosion due to the presence of molybdenum in their composition. Apart from this, they have good thermal and electrical conductivity as well as good elongation properties. They are widely used in transformers, heat exchangers, oil refineries, space research, etc. We are one of the top Alloy Steel Gr 5 Sheet manufacturers and suppliers in the country, who focuses on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The SA387 Gr 5 Plate is alloyed with different elements with different quantities. These plates can be customized to have desired properties that are required by our clients. The Astm A387 Gr 5 Cl 1 Hot Rolled Plates are produced by rolling steel in hot mills at temperatures above 1700° F. This is above most steel's recrystallization temperature thereby ensuring the steel is easy to form and the subsequent products easy to work with. Chrome Molybdenum Gr 5 Strip is a highly requested strip in the engineering sector. These strips are easy to install and are highly durable. Our experienced workers use the best raw materials and the latest technology to produce the best products.

Astm A387 Grade 5 Class 1 Foil is used to cover tools or material when they are heat treated in industries. These non-magnetic foil help reduce the problem of intergranular corrosion during the welding process. The Grade 5 Alloy Steel Coil withstand temperatures up to 816 Degree C. They can be either cold or hot rolled. If you have any queries regarding our Alloy Steel Gr 5 Sheet or their pricing, contact us for more information.

This sheet is designed to work in harsh environments where most materials would be attacked by acids and destroyed within a few years. We are one of the top Alloy Steel Grade 11 Sheet manufacturers in the country for the last decade. We focus on creating the best products at the best prices.

All our products can be customized into different shapes and sizes to meet specific requirements.

Chrome Molybdenum Gr 11 Shim Stock is high corrosion-resistant material, which is inserted amongst parts in industrial apparatus. This stock provides support, levels, adjust tools. This versatile material can be easily cut with scissors or shears depending on its thickness. The Sa 387 Gr 11 Cl 2 Foil is a non-magnetic tape, which is used to wrap industrial materials, as they are heat-treated. These foils help prevent intergranular corrosion caused due to welding. description: Alloys are used to manufacture various plates and sheets. They can be either carbon, steel, or Nickel Alloy plates. These plates display resistance to severe corrosion and greater strength. However, if no chromium is added to the alloy then the resistance to corrosion may decrease. These plates can also be used in diluted solutions of sulfuric and hydrochloric acid. It also offers resistance to alkalis that are caustic. Nickel Alloy Strip also performs well in marine environments by resisting cavitation corrosion. It offers good ductility and is easy to weld and solder. They are also said to generate high thermal and electrical conductivity.

Alloy 200 Sheet provides decent magnetic and mechanical properties. Therefore these alloy sheets are also known as ferromagnetic alloys. Exposure of this grade to a temperature range of 800 degrees F to 1200 degrees F leads to precipitation of carbon phase and loss of ductility. In case one is searching for an alloy sheet for application above 600 degrees F then Nickel 201 Plates are used. Resistance to creep needs to be considered as a designing factor for applications whose service temperature reaches 800 degrees F. Cold working these plates increases the tensile strength of these plates significantly.

Nickel 200 Plate is made up of commercially pure wrought nickel. They display resistance in neutral salt solutions as well. However, the metal comes under severe attack and corrodes in an oxidizing environment. They also have the ability to resist dry chlorine and hydrogen chloride. JIS NW 2201 Foil functions well in reducing conditions. They are widely used in soap industries to make soap. In the case of the formation of a passive oxide film on the plate then they can also be used in an oxidizing environment. UNS N02200 Coil is widely used in industries such as power generation, seawater equipment, pulp and paper, condenser, pharmaceutical, and gas processing.

description: Hastelloy C276 is a superalloy composed of nickel, chromium, and molybdenum alloy. The presence of molybdenum makes them highly resistant to pitting and crevice corrosion. The ASTM B575 UNS N10276 Plate is the most used alloy plate in the industry. These sheets can be easily hardened by precipitation, solid solution, and work hardening methods. This sheet is seen in chemical industries, municipal waste treatment, paper, pulp, evaporators, heat exchangers, digesters and many other industries. Over the last decade, we have been the leading manufacturer and supplier of Hastelloy C276 Sheet. We ensure that the products we produce are top quality and available at reasonable rates to all.

The ASTM B575 UNS N10276 Strip has good tensile and yield strength. These strips are manufactured in a solution under annealed and descaled conditions. The C276 Alloy Coil can either be produced by hot-rolling or subsequent cold-rolling procedures. They are widely requested in the construction industry. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology following international and national standards.

2.4819 Alloy C276 Foil is a non-magnetic tape, which reduces carbide precipitation during the process of welding. They are also used to cover industrial tools when they are subjected to heat treatment. All our products including the C276 Hastelloy Strips can be customized in different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. If you have any queries about our Hastelloy products, contact us.

The Nickel Alloy 400 Plate is designed with good tensile strength and mechanical properties. Monel sheets are widely used for marine engineering, chemical industries, fasteners, etc. We are one of the top manufacturers and distributors of the Monel 400 Sheet, and our main focus is creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The hot or cold rolling process produces most material in an industrial setting. The 2.4360 Monel 400 Hot Rolled Sheet is produced by treating these sheets at extreme temperatures. This ensures that they are easily formed and the subsequent products from these sheets are easy to work with. The Monel 400 Grade Cold Rolled Foil is formed after further processing from hot rolling. This foil is wrapped around tools when they are heat-treated. All our products can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per your needs.

The ASTM B127 UNS N04400 Strip is a narrow plate, which can be easily customized. This stock is used as lining to fill gaps in structures of large magnitude. These strips can also be used to produce pipes and tubes of the same grade. UNS N04400 Shim Stock helps stabilize and support structures in different industrial set-ups. We manufacture all our products using the best raw materials and latest technology. This is done following international as well as national standards while manufacturing and supplying all our products. If you have any questions regarding our products or their pricing, contact us.

description: Sheets are made up of various alloys and metals. One such alloy is the copper and zinc alloy that aids in making Brass Sheet. They display good resistance to corrosion and high electrical conductivity along with excellent durability. They are easy to machine, fabricate, or cut and have a shiny decorative, and aesthetically attractive appearance. Thin brass sheet is used in manufacturing, construction, electrical, plumbing, and many other applications. The zinc proportion changes the properties of these sheets. Where less zinc portion makes it ductile and workable. On the other hand, more zinc makes it strong.

These pipes are put through various treatments and annealing is one such treatment. Annealing brass Plate reduces the hardness thereby enhancing the ductility, machinability, and toughness. The brittleness of the material is also reduce by heating and cooling of the material. It also enhances the electrical conductivity and magnetic ability of the product. One of the major drawbacks of annealing Brass Coil is that it is a time consuming process and takes time to cool. Especially if they are kept in the furnace to cool naturally. They are annealed between a temperature range of 300 to 410 degrees C.

Brass Alloy C23000 Coil do not require to be replaced frequently due to corrosion or rusting unlike plates made up of various other metals. These C27400 Brass Plates are passed through various tests before the final product is packed. These tests ensure that the qualities of the alloy are maintained at the highest possible level. UNS C27200 Strip is widely produced and stocked at our warehouse. This helps us to meet the urgent demand of our customers without wasting time.
